''R6'' - mattgrant |rarity = {{Color|Common}} |looped = Yes |music = Yes |moveable = No |oldmusic = '''Music Version 1''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Poisoned Version 1|thumb|center|250px]] |newmusic = '''Music Version 2''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Poisoned v2|thumb|center|250px]] |music-3 = '''Current Music''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Poisoned 2024|thumb|center|250px]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Do you think this is easy?!|Store Description}} {{QuoteBox|Epic guy dance|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Poisoned''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been bought in the store for {{Coins|500}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/20391411/profile STEALTH_NOVA]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote. While it does appear in the emote wheel, it cannot be used at all. Additionally, it does not appear in the inventory. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}} Poisoned.gif|First version (19 July 2019 – 29 October 2020) }} ==Trivia== *This [[Emotes|emote]] is based from the game ''Fortnite'' which had an emote called [[w:c:Fortnite:Dance Moves|Dance Moves]]. **This in turn was based on the dance [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=81NpdkTcMAE Turk performs] in the television show ''Scrubs''. *The original music used by this emote had to be replaced due to copyright issues. **The original music was a snippet of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V_oD7NHRWxU a mashup] of Dance Moves' music. *The second music used by this emote was shared with [[Boston Breakdance]]. *This emote used to be visible when switching between the towers and emotes section of the inventory, with the text "''Yo momma''" as its description. **This was used as a placeholder. ==Update History== *'''19 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.6|BETA v1.6.0]] **'''Poisoned''' added. *'''27 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.6|BETA v1.6.2]] **Music replaced. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Poisoned''' removed. *'''2 October 2024''' - [[v1.34.0]] **'''Poisoned''' re-added. **Animation changed. **Music replaced. **Price in store decreased from {{Coins|2,000}} to {{Coins|500}}. **No longer moveable. **{{Bug}} '''Poisoned''' has no animations and cannot be used. **{{Bug}} '''Poisoned''' uses [[Dab]]'s icon. **{{Bug}} '''Poisoned''' uses [[Popcorn]]'s animation in emote preview. *'''2 October 2024''' - [[v1.34.0|v1.34.5]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Poisoned''' now has animations and is now usable. *'''16 October 2024''' - [[v1.36.0]] **'''Poisoned''' can no longer be obtained. **{{Bug}} '''Poisoned''' has no animations and cannot be used. **{{Bug}} '''Poisoned''' no longer appears in the inventory. {{EmoteNavBox}}
